purpose: Ordered production stages from blueprint through final output.

stages.description: Assemble narrative blueprint with act structure, arcs, and callback design.
Generate scene sequence, registry, and continuity map from blueprint.
Assemble shot sequence, coverage map, and dependency graph from scenes.
Derive generation prompts from shot coverage and continuity anchors.
Execute image generation with identity consistency validation.
Execute video generation with motion and transition consistency validation.
Assemble editorial timeline with coverage and callback alignment.
Deliver production-ready final output with full traceability chain.
